title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Steamships Trading Company is seeking a dynamic and technically proficient Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our Talent Acquisition team. This role will provide strategic support to the Talent Acquisition Manager and facilitate the end-to-end recruitment process for the Steamships Corporate division, ensuring the delivery of high-quality hires in a timely manner.
In addition to recruitment coordination, the Talent Acquisition Specialist will play a key role in building talent pipelines and contributing to employer branding initiatives that strengthen Steamships’ position as an employer of choice.
What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities)
End-to-End Recruitment Delivery
Talent Pooling & Workforce Planning Support
Compliance & Reporting
Capability Building & Stakeholder Enablement
Candidate Experienc & Employer Branding
What You Will Bring (Requirements)
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Management, or related field.
Experience:
Minimum 2-3 years of recruitment experience, preferably in a multi-division or large-scale organisation.
Experience using applicant tracking systems and recruitment analytics tools.
Technical & Functional Competencies:
Strong sourcing and networking skills.
Excellent organisational and time management abilities.
Effective communication and relationship-building skills.
Attention to detail and process discipline.
Behavioural Competencies:
Adaptability in managing high-volume and urgent recruitment.
Customer centric and focused
